name: web-to-cli
description: A template for a CLI that reads a website for a person in a real browser and builds its own ops through awf workflows.

scripts.ci:check: bun run lint && bun run type-check && bun run test && bun run test:workflows
scripts.ci:fast: bun run ci:sandbox && bun run test:workflows
scripts.ci:sandbox: bun run lint && bun run type-check && bun run test:fast
